messages:
PagerBot: INCIDENT PAGER — unusual prefix-cache miss surge observed in prod-rf around 21:05 UTC, auto-escalation to oncall. Alert ID: PB-2145-CCM
PagerBot: Symptoms: 10-20x prefix KV miss rate increase, tail latency spike for tokenized generation > 800ms, several 502s logged.

alice-ng-oncall: Acked. I'm taking incident lead. Starting a short timeline and grabbing traces. Putting a lightweight incident channel for comms.
ben-sre: On-call now too. First ask: which route/model is seeing the miss? Any recent rollouts?
carla-runtime: Checking rollout history — no model variants deployed in the past 3 hours. Routing changes: a routing policy tweak to prefer cheaper variants was flipped at 20:40 by infra-bot. Could be related.
dinesh-support: Customer signals: 3 enterprise customers reported degraded responses for chat flows (timeouts + duplicate tokens). I have their org IDs and sample request IDs. Sharing in thread.

alice-ng-oncall: Good. Priorities: 1) confirm scope (routes/regions/customers), 2) collect logs for KV prefix hits, 3) apply mitigations if pattern confirmed. Ben, can you pull prefix hit histograms 20:30-21:10?
ben-sre: Pulling now. Query against `redis-prefix-hits` shows a sharp drop in hitrate at ~20:47 UTC for `prefix:k-*` and `prefix:user-session-*`. Baseline hitrate ~86% -> fell to ~12% for several minutes.
carla-runtime: That matches our internal metric `kv.prefix.hitrate` on prod-rf. Also seeing elevated eviction counters and a short surge of GC on the prefix index. Possible mass invalidation or metadata rebuild.

logbot: Pasted logs for the window 20:45-20:55 (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T20:46:02Z [runtime] INFO prefix_manager: invalidating prefix bucket shard=12 reason=policy-update
2026-03-15T20:46:03Z [runtime] WARN kv_cache: eviction storm count=1520 ttl_sync=miss
2026-03-15T20:46:06Z [router] INFO route-evaluator: switched policy=cost_optimized -> policy=latency_sensitive
2026-03-15T20:46:07Z [metrics] ERROR cache_reprobe: rewarm_failures=38
2026-03-15T20:47:10Z [api] ERROR responses: 502 code=E_CACHE_MISS upstream_retries=0
```

alice-ng-oncall: Interesting — two correlated events: 20:46 policy flip + prefix invalidation. Hypothesis A: the policy change triggered a prefix invalidation path that mass-evicted KV entries, causing immediate miss storm. Hypothesis B: concurrent background job (TTL sync) overlapped and caused TTLs to look expired.

ben-sre: Repro steps to validate: 1) check index-rebuild logs for `prefix-manager` across shards, 2) correlate eviction counts with rewarm queue length, 3) inspect the policy-change deploy logs. If eviction > rewarm throughput, hitrate will tank.

carla-runtime: I'm pulling the rewarm queue metrics now. Rewarm concurrency had been throttled to 4 by autoscaler due to a separate capacity optimization that started at 19:55. That would limit refill throughput. If invalidation was large, rewarm couldn't keep up.
dinesh-support: From customer traces, requests that hit the cold path retried and some clients timed out at 10s. Opening a case for those orgs and sending suggested mitigations to keep them informed.

alice-ng-oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) flip routing policy back to previous to stop further invalidations (carla, can you rollback the policy flip?), 2) bump rewarm concurrency to 16 temporarily, 3) enable prefix warmup for the top 50 prefixes observed in customer traffic. Confirm before acting.

carla-runtime: Rolling back policy flip now: `POST /api/policy/rollback policy=cost_optimized -> applied` (logs: deploy-req 2145-rollback). Confirmed.
carla-runtime: Increasing rewarm workers to 16: `kubectl -n runtime scale deployment/prefix-rewarmer --replicas=16` — scaling in progress.

ben-sre: After rollback + scale, within ~90s we see hitrate recovering from 12% -> 68% on the busiest prefixes. Latency tail drops back under 200ms. Looks promising.

alice-ng-oncall: Good. Marking mitigation applied. Next: assemble timeline for RCA and collect artifacts. Who can own timeline assembly and hypothesis tracking?
ben-sre: I will own the timeline and produce a concise sequence with metric screenshots. Will attach links to Grafana panels: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv/hitrate?from=168946... (link redacted)
carla-runtime: I'll own root-cause verification and codepath review for the invalidation routine. Suspect change in policy->invalidation workflow that didn't gate on current rewarm capacity.
eva-product: Noted customer impact. I'll prepare comms for impacted customers once we have an ETA and RCA draft. Please ping me when we have final scope (org ids + start/end).
dinesh-support: Customer list: org-1234, org-2345, org-9876. Attachments: sample request IDs and timestamps 20:46:10-20:48:12.

logbot: Collected artifacts attached: `s3://redwood-logs/incidents/2145012345/prefix-invalidations.log`, `s3://redwood-metrics/snapshots/2145012345/hitrate.png`

alice-ng-oncall: Hypothesis tracker (quick):
- H1: Policy flip triggered broad prefix invalidation path (leading) — evidence: invalidation logs at 20:46 + policy change at 20:46:06.
- H2: Rewarm throughput insufficient due to earlier autoscaler optimization — evidence: rewarmer replicas=4, queue saturation.
- H3: TTL sync holiday — low priority, need to check TTL sync job overlap.

ben-sre: Tests to prove H1: run a dry-run policy flip in staging with a similar prefix set size and observe invalidation + rewarm backlog. I can run that in ~1h. For the immediate RCA, H1+H2 are the working theory.

carla-runtime: Code path note: the `policy-update` hook calls `prefix_manager.invalidate(shard, aggressive=true)` without checking `rewarmer.available()`. That's risky. If both happen concurrently, we starve the rewarm path. I'll open a PR to add gating and a backoff.

alice-ng-oncall: Recording action items:
- ben-sre: assemble timeline + Grafana snippets (ETA 2h)
- carla-runtime: PR to gate invalidation (link PR when ready), add safe fallback in policy path (ETA 6h)
- infra: review autoscaler policy that reduced rewarm concurrency earlier (owner: @infra-team)
- dinesh-support & eva-product: customer comms draft after RCA stub (ETA 3h)

eva-product: I'll draft a customer note asking affected customers to expect RCA in 24 hours and an interim mitigation summary.

alice-ng-oncall: Final notes before handing off: severity downgraded to Sev3 now that mitigation recovered hitrate and latency; but we still need a full RCA and a permanent fix. Handing ops to ben-sre for timeline + writeup. I'll move to watch-only. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

ben-sre: Taking ownership of postmortem draft and will ping for PR review. Adding timeline entries and logs.

PagerBot: Incident PB-2145-CCM status changed -> mitigated; responders: alice-ng-oncall, ben-sre, carla-runtime, dinesh-support, eva-product.

alice-ng-oncall: Closing real-time coordination. Follow-ups in #postmortems and link will be posted when the RCA is created. If anything regresses, re-open.
